scope: Retrospective CPU analysis of two already released development panels on the same original training complaints. Not independent confirmation, new inference, or an official score.
contrast: Two visits minus one within the same payload and framing. Do not combine the two framings as independent data.
endpoint: Rank the gold intent using the stored unrounded probabilities for all 77 legal choices. Use descending probability and original choice index for exact ties. Report deterministic rank-one, top-three, top-five and mean reciprocal rank; retain tie bounds. No temperature adjustment.
flow: Count gold-rank moves between ranks 1, 2, 3-5 and 6+. Distinguish an old runner-up becoming first from an intent newly entering the top five.
sample: All development rows from the 512 pinned training complaint groups. Preserve complete duplicates. The 16 sampling strata each contributed 32 groups.

bootstrap.intervals: paired pointwise 95%; row-weighted within each resample

reconcile: Every first-place numerator must reproduce the corresponding released full-precision probability score. This is not a rerun of the native rounded typed decoder.
